research_motto: DON'T JUST DETECT THE SIGNAL. UNDERSTAND THE CONTEXT.
scope_label: Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026) Student Innovation Prototype
scope_notice: Proposed OS/device-level intelligent security layer situated at the mobile interaction boundary. Validated through prototype implementation and empirical ML benchmarks.
hero_subtitle: Context-aware AI defense protecting citizens across phishing, social engineering, coerced OTPs, and emerging synthetic media fraud.
scanner_subheading: Select threat modality to initiate contextual feature extraction and cross-channel risk analysis.
assistant_idle: Tap microphone to begin voice safety check
persona_student_desc: Safeguarded against fake internship tasks, student loan scams, and exam fee phishing.
persona_professional_desc: Protected against CEO wire fraud, payroll email spoofing, and LinkedIn recruitment phishing.
persona_senior_desc: Guarded against digital arrest calls, pension KYC coercion, and remote desktop scams.
persona_rural_desc: Shielded against reverse UPI QR traps, electricity bill disconnection SMS, and lottery claims.
emergency_step1_desc: Disconnect the voice/video call or cease SMS/WhatsApp replies immediately. Do not disclose doubts to the caller.
emergency_step2_desc: Open your mobile banking app to temporarily block UPI and debit cards, or call your bank's 24x7 emergency helpline.
emergency_step3_desc: Call 1930 immediately (National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal helpline) to report financial fraud within the golden hour.
emergency_step4_desc: Take uncropped screenshots of SMS messages, call logs, QR codes, payment receipts (UTR numbers), and phone numbers.
emergency_step5_desc: Lodge an official cyber complaint at the Government of India portal: https://cybercrime.gov.in.
